purpose: Verify pi agent running in headless (non-interactive) mode on a task that requires the alza MCP server: startup → MCP config load → alza connect → tool discovery → tools/call → live Alza search → final answer.
task_prompt: Use the alza MCP server: search Alza for 'čistič na kolo', sorted by price ascending, only in-stock items, max price 300 CZK, limit 5. Report the cheapest product's name, price, product code, and Alza URL. Answer as a short 5-line list.

run_1.tool_discovery: adapter meta-tool search 'alza search product' → alza_search_products ranked #1 (score 413), schema shape surfaced
run_1.final_answer:
- Product: Force Strong na řetězy láhev 0,5 l růžový
- Price: 139 CZK (in stock)
- Product code: SPTfor0202
- Alza URL: https://www.alza.cz/sport/force-strong-na-retezy-lahev-0-5-l-ruzovy-d12572579.htm
- Note: cheapest of 5 in-stock results for "čistič na kolo" ≤ 300 CZK
run_1.finding: results were NOT sorted ascending (209, 229, 139, 269, 169) — model still identified the cheapest correctly

sort_finding.evidence: direct probes of https://www.alza.cz/search.htm?exps=… with o=0, o=2, o=3 (and hash #sort_N) all return identical relevance order; Alza's sort control is client-side JS (a.js-sort-item → #sort_0/1/2/5/6), not honored server-side
sort_finding.fix: client-side sort in CatalogDomain.searchProducts via exported compareForSort (price-asc/price-desc/rating applied to the fetched page; missing prices/ratings sort last); honest description + param docs updated

run_2.confirmation: results now sorted ascending (139 → 169 …); model reported runner-up correctly
